sources.title: GitHub - jakejharris/jspark3: Three-DGX-Spark TP3 serving recipe for ...
sources.snippet: Run GLM-5.3 Flash across three NVIDIA DGX Sparks as one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with a reproducible TP3 recipe and public benchmarks. Cadence adds a measured single-stream decode mode and carries the long-context kernel fix. It is a serving recipe, not a new model: JSpark3 trains nothing, quantizes nothing, and changes no checkpoint weight bytes. Install · Benchmarks · Limitations ...
